instruction: I am grading students' English exam papers. After comparing the remaining students' answers with the answer key and recording the detailed scoring in the spreadsheet, please identify one student who got exactly 7 questions correct (missed exactly 3 questions) and write their name in cell O3.

Agent must: 1) Grade all 9 students, 2) Find student(s) with score=70, 3) Write one of their names in cell O3.
